title: schoenus niveus
intro: Schoenus niveus, commonly known as snow sedge, is a perennial aquatic plant species belonging to the family Cyperaceae. It has been reported to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Schoenus niveus include its potential to treat wounds, reduce fever, and act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Schoenus niveus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
